class.name: CbLink
class.brief_description: A rope between the player and something else, for as long as its motion is on. A grappling hook's rope, two players bound together.
class.description: A child of a [CbMotion]. While the motion is on, the player and the target cannot be further apart than the rope is long: slack, it does nothing; taut, it pulls the two back together. What that takes is shared by what they weigh: the world gives nothing (you swing), a light crate comes along behind you, and of two players the lighter one is dragged more. The target is what the motion's [CbProbe] found (the default), or the entity a field names: [member CbMotionEffect.target] cannot be the player itself. A rope has no direction of its own. A [CbLinkLook] draws the rope of a probe.

members.member: The rope's length, in metres. 0: as long as the two are apart when the probe takes hold (so a motion without a [CbProbe] has to give a length).
With a length of 0: metres of rope taken in a second, so the two end up together. The rope is never shorter than a metre.
